name: iris-firebase-rules
description: Firestore security rules and their tests. Kept out of the app's package.json on purpose — firebase-tools is heavy and the React Native app must never depend on it.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulated
scripts.test:emulated: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project iris-rules-test 'node --test rules.test.mjs applyIntent.test.mjs drainOutbox.test.mjs handleEvent.test.mjs'
